manifest_row.title: When did the Anthropocene begin on Earth?

screening.main_topic: The timing and geographic spread of human transformation of the environment, especially through agriculture, as context for defining the Anthropocene.
screening.climate_relevance: The article connects land use and agriculture with carbon emissions and lasting changes to the global climate, and notes that archaeological reconstructions may underestimate land-use-associated climate effects.
screening.reason: The main focus is archaeological evidence about the origins and extent of the Anthropocene, not climate change itself. Climate impacts are meaningfully discussed as part of the broader account of human environmental transformation, so the text is relevant as peripheral discourse.
